title: So very worth it
text: So very worth it. This is just right for the price. We have had it for about 3 months now and it is holding up well. We are living in a small apartment and wanted a small coffee table without a hugr investment just yet. My toddler eats on it, drinks go on it, books, meals, everything really. We even use it as a foot rest lol and no wiggle yet. Its super easy to wipe down too. I truly believe it will hold.up for at the least a year. And if we are still not ready for a bigger investment a year from now, and if somehow its not holding up anymore, we will buy again. It just is perfect for anyone in the "in between" stage of life lol
